title: CarrierCost
description: What Norvia pays a Carrier for one Carrier booking, as the TMS calculates it at release from the Carrier's Carrier Rate Card and freezes on the Carrier booking (Canonical Model document, version 1). It is never recalculated: a new release after a rejection makes a new Carrier booking with a newly calculated Carrier cost. It is never the Shipper's Freight Charge. Carried by ShipmentReleased for a Carrier Shipment.

total.description: The sum of the charge lines, without VAT.

type.description: What the line charges for: always a Freight line, and a Minimum charge adjustment line when the Lane's minimum charge applies.

amount.description: Rounded to cents, half away from zero.

source.description: Where the Carrier cost came from.

kind.description: CarrierRateCard: priced from the Carrier's Carrier Rate Card.

rateCardVersion.description: The version of the Carrier's Carrier Rate Card the Carrier cost was calculated from: the one valid on the collection date.

calculatedAt.description: When the Carrier cost was calculated: when the Shipment was released.
